cohort: 45 preterm neonates (<34 weeks gestational age) treated with darbepoetin alfa for anemia of prematurity, compared to 45 randomly selected preterm neonates not receiving darbepoetin alfa
finding: Short-term administration of darbepoetin alfa did not significantly affect the absolute neutrophil counts or the rates of neutropenia or severe neutropenia in preterm neonates treated for anemia of prematurity.
